Ardila-Brugalle The double Gromov-Witten invariants of Hirzebruch surfaces are piecewise polynomial (arXiv:1412.4563): F2 floor diagram with divergence (x,y), complex/double invariants and piecewise polynomiality; no real Welschinger-signed elevator product.

Cooper A Fock space approach to Severi degrees of Hirzebruch surfaces (2025, doi:10.1090/btran/46) and Cavalieri-Johnson-Markwig-Ranganathan Fock-space theory: complex/descendant Severi degrees for all F_k including F2; implies complex x^2 gluing but prescribes no real signs, so does not imply parity kill.

Brugalle Recursive formulas for Welschinger invariants of the projective plane (IMRN rnq096) and Blomme / Brugalle floor-conic papers: real Caporaso-Harris for plane only; different surface and divergence sequence, no F2 elevator ledger.
